Top News Highlights  
1. Alibaba announces the establishment of the Alibaba Token Hub (ATH) business group, directly overseen by CEO Wu Yongming.  
2. Sam’s Club urgently removes popular product after heavy metal contamination exposure.  
3. Lincoln owner claims air conditioning left them numb from cold after 7 dealership visits; manufacturer responds: "You’re too sensitive."

Today’s Headline  
Alibaba Announces Establishment of Alibaba Token Hub (ATH) Business Group, Directly Overseen by CEO Wu Yongming  
On the afternoon of March 16, Alibaba announced the establishment of the Alibaba Token Hub (ATH) business group, directly overseen by CEO Wu Yongming. ATH includes the Tongyi Lab, MaaS business line, Qianwen Business Unit, Wukong Business Unit, and AI Innovation Business Unit, covering a complete layout from foundational model R&D and model service platforms to AI applications for individuals and enterprises.  
The establishment of Alibaba’s ATH business group centers on the core objectives of "creating tokens, delivering tokens, and applying tokens."

excerpt_i18n.en: Users of thin-and-light laptops are becoming increasingly "demanding." At the sharing session for the third-generation Intel Core Ultra processors, Feng Dawei, Vice President of Intel's Client Computing Group, captured the core challenge of today's PC market with this statement. For over a decade, consumers buying thin-and-light laptops faced a single-choice question: opting for extreme portability meant compromising on performance; pursuing long battery life often required sacrificing screen quality and graphics capabilities; and desiring powerful computing inevitably led to bulky designs and constant battery anxiety. But today, this trade-off is being redefined. Feng Dawei stated plainly, "Today’s users demand not only extreme thinness and lightness but also exceptional performance and experience; they want all-day stable battery life, along with premium build quality and a comprehensive set of ports." This "want-it-all" demand is not unreasonable but rather a natural outcome of technological evolution and market maturity—China boasts the world’s most discerning consumers and the richest application scenarios, where every technological revolution is quickly tested, amplified, and implemented. Driven by such user insights, Intel introduced the third-generation Core Ultra processor (codenamed Panther Lake) at the 18A process node. This iteration represents Intel’s deepest integration of process and architecture in its history, embodying a simple yet bold vision: to make thinness, performance, and battery life in thin-and-light laptops no longer an "impossible triangle." While the industry still debates "what should be sacrificed first in thin-and-light laptops," Intel has answered with a single product: nothing.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los usuarios de portátiles ultraligeros se están volviendo cada vez más "exigentes". En la sesión de intercambio sobre los procesadores Intel Core Ultra de tercera generación, Feng Dawei, vicepresidente de la división de computación para clientes de Intel, señaló con una frase el núcleo de la actual propuesta del mercado de PC. Durante la última década, comprar un portátil ultraligero era como resolver una pregunta de opción única: si se deseaba una portabilidad extrema, había que aceptar compromisos en rendimiento; si se buscaba una larga duración de batería, a menudo se sacrificaba la calidad de pantalla y la capacidad gráfica; y si se anhelaba un poder de cálculo potente, había que conformarse con un cuerpo grueso y la constante ansiedad por la batería. Pero hoy, esta elección está siendo redefinida. Feng Dawei afirmó directamente: "Los usuarios actuales exigen tanto una extrema ligereza como un rendimiento y una experiencia excepcionales".

items.raw_excerpt: 近日，达能亚太与阿里云达成战略合作。双方将围绕“AI+健康”的愿景，在全栈AI、大数据及亚太区域公共云合作等多个领域深度共创，共同打造面向AI时代的数智化平台与敏捷组织。 达能全球CIO Erwin Logt、阿里云智能集团资深副总裁，公共云事业部总裁刘伟光见证签约，达能亚太CIO Shivani Saini与阿里云智能集团公共云事业部副总裁、东区总经理解航代表双方签约，达能中国、北亚及大洋洲信息技术&数据副总裁刘冰等出席签约仪式。 作为一家知名的跨国食品饮料公司，达能在专注健康、快速发展并引领潮流的三大领域开展业务：专业特殊营养、基础乳制品和植物基产品、饮用水和饮料。旗下拥有爱他美、诺优能、脉动、依云等家喻户晓的品牌。 过往，达能中国基于阿里云的公共云全栈技术，成功打造了高效、安全、合规的企业级云平台，不仅有力支撑了企业应用服务的敏捷创新，更极大提升了中国消费者的数字化体验。 面向AI时代，阿里云将全力支持达能将中国的数字化成功经验推广至其他亚太区域，并将协助达能打造具有行业标杆效应的“Landing Zone”企业治理范式和全栈AI最佳实践。 在AI Agent领域，双方将结合阿里巴巴生态资源，在市场营销、电商、渠道销售、客户服务及供应链等关键业务领域，基于千问大模型共同构建场景化的AI智能体，提升达能运营效率和消费者体验。 同时，双方将利用阿里云全球领先的模型与算力服务，以支持达能更高效地研发和创新，并加速健康科技成果转化。 此外，双方还将基于阿里云先进的数据产品和技术升级新一代数据湖，构建“Talk-to-Data”（对话式数据分析）能力，大幅提升企业级数据洞察效率与决策智能化水平，加速业务转型。 此次战略签约，标志着阿里云与达能的合作进一步迈向业务智能化。达能将持续利用先进的数字化技术，持续为全球消费者提供更健康、更优质的产品与服务体验。 雷峰网
